_comment: Synthetic sensitive-trigger fixtures for REQ-43 (Iris Policy Rules R-3). No real parent words. Each must escalate with its flag.

fixtures.text: Hi Charlie, I think I was charged twice for October. Can you check?
We did not authorize this payment on the card.
The invoice shows the wrong amount. We were overcharged this month.
If this is not fixed I will file a chargeback with my bank.
I have spoken to a lawyer about the missed classes.
I will leave a bad review and contact the Better Business Bureau.
Things are hard at home and I worry she might hurt herself.
There was a family emergency last night and the police were called.
He told the school counsellor about abuse, so we need to stop for now.
His grandmother passed away, so he will miss this week.
My husband lost his job and we can’t afford classes right now.
She is in the hospital after surgery and will be away.
Can we get a refund for the classes we did not use?
I would like my money back for September.
Please reimburse the two sessions that were cancelled.
